entries.389aff699ca89460: This business covers support after system launch, and provides comprehensive support for installed systems and corporate activities through office supply provision, hardware and software maintenance, telephone support, outsourcing services and more. Centered on the mail-order service “Tanomēru” and the support service “Tayorēru,” the company focuses on stock businesses that generate recurring revenue. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥419,875 million (up 10.5% year on year). The partial change in classification method and the year-on-year calculation are the same as for the System Integration Business.
entries.603b06c16527cdf6: It is a business brand that supports customers' information systems and overall corporate activities, and is another 1 of the stock businesses that the Service & Support Business focuses on.
entries.63cdc267a8989b6e: This business covers the construction and operation of information systems, providing customers with systems tailored to their needs, from consulting through system design and development, equipment delivery and installation work, to network construction. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥902,915 million (up 24.1% year on year), the larger of the two reportable segments. In this period, personal computers captured replacement demand and grew strongly, and packaged software also grew strongly. In addition, from this period the company revised part of the performance management categories of its consolidated subsidiaries and partly changed the method of classifying the two businesses. Year-on-year comparisons are calculated by restating the prior-year figures under the new categories, and the filing states that the effect is minor.
